correctness.rationale: The primary source directly verifies both imported formulas. Example 11 gives the \((23)\)-ordered value as \(\sum_{k=0}^{\ell_{12}}\binom{\ell_{12}}k\zeta(-\ell_{11}-\ell_{12}+k)\zeta(-\ell_{22}-k)\), so at \(\ell_{12}=0\) it is \(\zeta(-a)\zeta(-c)\). Example 19 gives the regular value; at \(\ell_{12}=0\) it is \(\zeta(-a)\zeta(-c)+(-1)^{c+1}\zeta(-a-c-1)/(c+1)\). Thus simultaneous vanishing is equivalent to the product vanishing and \(\zeta(-a-c-1)=0\). The classical negative-integer trivial zeros then give exactly \(a,c\ge1\) and odd \(a+c\), including the boundary exclusions \(a=0\) or \(c=0\).
